versions.changelog:
Initial release.

- Provides step-by-step workflow to initialize Spec-Driven Development (SDD) using OpenSpec in any project.
- Supports both OpenSpec-native and non-native Agent CLI tools; includes detailed bridging instructions.
- Guides automatic detection and configuration of project context in openspec/config.yaml.
- Covers manual mirroring and adaptation for unsupported tools like atomcode and zcode.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and workflow caveats to ensure smooth setup.
